_comment: Fake creatives for the sponsored-links dev server. Edited live: the server re-reads this file on every request. A creative applies to any link whose host is one of `domains` or a subdomain of one. Omit bannerUrl/logoUrl to get generated SVG art in the `accent` color. `did`/`handle` are optional; use a real handle to make the sponsor link resolve in the app.

creatives.text: Online meetings that don't make you angry.
We bring democracy to the internet.
